lines.cyr: Само ме гледаш, очи ми пиеш
lines.lat: Samo me gledaš, oči mi pieš
lines.en: You only look at me, you drink my eyes

lines.cyr: но ни збор јас не чув
lines.lat: no ni zbor jas ne čuv
lines.en: but I have not heard a single word
that you would say to me.
Ah, darling, oh darling [x2]

lines.cyr: но ни збор јас не чув
lines.lat: no ni zbor jas ne čuv
lines.en: but I have not heard a single word
that you would say to me.
Come, come, darling
let my eyes be yours
for like flowers they will wither
come, darling, you.

but I have not heard a word
